_real_world.designation: AGM-158C LRASM (Long Range Anti-Ship Missile), LRASM 1.1 fleet configuration
_real_world.role: Long-range, low-observable, autonomous-terminal-homing anti-ship cruise missile; F/A-18E/F is the threshold CVW-8 carrier launch platform
_real_world.guidance_real: GPS/INS (anti-jam) midcourse with datalink; passive RF + imaging-infrared (IIR) terminal seeker; autonomous target selection/discrimination without reliance on continuous GPS or datalink in the terminal phase
_real_world.speed: High subsonic, low-observable sea-skimming terminal profile
_real_world.mount_mapping: none — no NavalWeaponType exists for anti-ship missiles (per authoring_standard.md's Mechanism Gaps section); placed in CVW-8 aircraft default_loadout and _real_world.weapon_inventory as a content-only record; the repo already carries a P5-packet reference record (eq-us-weapon-agm158c) for this weapon, this CSG record supplies the full Missile-schema flight/guidance/warhead/fuze fields that reference lacked

mass_kg.note: 1,020-1,250 kg bounded estimate per the CSG order-of-battle page (NAVAIR A + Lockheed Martin C); midpoint 1,135 kg used

max_flight_time_s.note: engineering estimate derived from the sourced >200 nmi range (370+ km) at the used 260 m/s cruise-speed proxy; precise C-1 range is classified per the OOB page

flight_model.max_speed.note: 'High subsonic' qualitative figure per Lockheed Martin (OOB page); ~0.8 Mach sea-level ~260 m/s used as engineering estimate, no precise public number

flight_model.max_g.note: no public maneuver-load figure; engineering estimate for a sea-skimming low-observable anti-ship cruise missile's terminal maneuver, matching the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern

flight_model.max_turn_rate.note: no public figure; engineering estimate marginally above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 10.0, reflecting LRASM's more capable autonomous terminal maneuvering per public qualitative claims, not quantified

guidance.type.note: GPS/INS midcourse + datalink, passive RF + IIR terminal seeker, autonomous target selection, per NAVAIR/Lockheed Martin (OOB page); ActiveRadar is used as the nearest matching real engine seeker_type since the engine's guidance.type vocabulary has no passive-RF/IIR-fusion category, and this record has no functional mount regardless (mechanism gap)

guidance.active_seek_range.note: no public seeker acquisition range (sensor weighting/terminal seeker performance explicitly classified per the OOB page); engineering estimate marginally above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 18000.0, reflecting LRASM's more advanced multi-mode terminal seeker qualitatively, not quantified

guidance.pn_los_rate_source.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, not a sourced weapon characteristic; record has no functional mount regardless

guidance.target_kinematics_estimator.note: standard engine guidance-model wiring default, same basis as pn_los_rate_source

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode is modeled for this mechanism-gap weapon

guidance.target_tracker_alpha.note: standard alpha-beta-gamma tracker filter constant, engine convention shared across missile records, not weapon-specific

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.target_tracker_gamma.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

guidance.nav_gain.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern; no public guidance-law constant

guidance.apn_target_accel_gain.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern

guidance.autopilot_tau_s.note: proxy copied unchanged from the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern

guidance.max_accel_response_g_per_s.note: engineering-estimate marginally below the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 60.0, consistent with the lower flight_model.max_g used here

warhead.type.note: 1,000-lb class WDU-42/B-family penetrating blast-fragmentation warhead per NAVAIR/Lockheed Martin (OOB page)

warhead.mass_kg.note: 450-454 kg (1,000-lb class WDU-42/B family) per the OOB page; midpoint 452 kg used

warhead.lethal_radius.note: engineering-estimate surrogate scaled above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 15.0, proportional to LRASM's roughly double warhead mass; no public lethal-radius figure

warhead.damage.note: engineering-estimate surrogate scaled above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 260.0, proportional to warhead mass; no public damage-effectiveness figure

warhead.explosive_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split of the sourced 452 kg total warhead mass, no public split figure

warhead.case_mass_kg.note: engineering-estimate HE/case split, see explosive_mass_kg; case mass set relatively high consistent with the WDU-42/B family's penetrating-warhead design intent

warhead.projection_radius_fraction.note: copied from the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's projection-geometry pattern

warhead.projection_max_radius_m.note: scaled above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 20.0, proportional to this warhead's larger lethal_radius

warhead.projection_max_projected_hitboxe.note: engineering-estimate marginally above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 3, reflecting the larger warhead's wider fragmentation footprint; not a quantified figure

fuze.type.note: no public fuze timing data; contact fuze is the nearest real engine-recognized fuze family for a penetrating anti-ship warhead's impact/delay exploder, matching the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched pattern

fuze.trigger_radius_m.note: 0.0 consistent with a contact-fuze trigger radius; no public influence-fuze standoff distance

fuze.delay_s.note: no public fuze timing data; engineering-estimate scaffold marginally above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 0.01, consistent with a larger penetrating warhead's slightly longer delay

fuze.reliability.note: no public reliability figure; engineering-estimate scaffold marginally above the repo CSG_US_Harpoon_Ship_Launched's 0.92, reflecting LRASM's newer/more mature fielded status (LRASM 1.1, fielded Nov 2023 per DOT&E FY25) qualitatively, not quantified

modeling_notes: No functional mount exists (mechanism gap, anti-ship missile); content-only for CVW-8 aircraft default_loadout and _real_world.weapon_inventory. Fleet configuration per DOT&E FY25 (OOB page): all AGM-158C upgraded to LRASM 1.1; the extended-range AGM-158C-3 variant is excluded from the 2025-26 baseline and not modeled. F/A-18E/F is the threshold carrier launch platform (not F-35C internal carriage).
